basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old knitter and fiber artist living in the Pacific Northwest. I spend my days working as a graphic designer and my nights exploring new yarns and patterns. I moved to Longview about two years ago, and have been loving the community vibe here. I often find myself wandering around Trader Joe's looking for seasonal goodies. I'm in a committed relationship with my partner of five years. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch break and late at night after my knitting sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Fine Arts with a focus on textile design, which fuels my passion for fiber arts. I learned knitting from my grandmother and refined my skills through online tutorials and community workshops. My graphic design skills are self-taught, and I frequently incorporate them into my crafting projects.
